claims.not_established: improvement versus the principal wave, causal benefit from history selection, independent encounter rates, population convergence, ecological success, or deployment fitness
claims.observed: 80 retained candidate assignments spanning 10 unique candidate genomes completed a second assigned 102.4-second physical horizon selected by native history-challenge rules, with authenticated physical and controller outcomes

final_telemetry.authentication: hash measured after atomic completion; no separate upstream telemetry manifest

final_trace.authentication: hash measured after atomic completion; no separate upstream trace manifest

post_ingest_search.interpretation: archive membership changed after history-challenge evaluations; these counts alone do not establish policy or ecological improvement

execution_attempt.scope: this invocation, including startup and checkpointing; excludes previous attempts

scope.interpretation: tick and contact-tick counts are temporal samples, not independent encounters
